name: SEO AI Audit Tool
author: Design

sections.description:
SEO AI Audit Tool revolutionizes how you optimize your WordPress website. Powered by advanced AI algorithms and integrating with Google Search Console and Ahrefs, this tool delivers actionable insights to boost your search rankings and conversion rates.

Learn More About Our SEO Audit Tool

👉 SEO AI Audit Tool Website
👉 Support (ask a question)
👉 Pricing

🎯 Key Features

SEO Fundamentals Audit

  • Keyword Optimization: Analyze and optimize your content’s keyword usage
  • Content Quality: Evaluate content structure and readability
  • Link Structure: Assess internal and external linking strategies
  • Image Optimization: Check image alt texts and optimization

Advanced SEO Analysis

  • AI-Powered Content Optimization: Get intelligent recommendations for content improvements
  • Search Intent Analysis: Understand user intent behind keywords
  • SERP Feature Analysis: Optimize for featured snippets and rich results
  • Focus Pages: Prioritize and track your most important pages

CRO Fundamentals Audit

  • Content Elements: Analyze embedded videos, tables of contents, and FAQ sections
  • Visual Structure: Evaluate listicle formats, charts, and graphs
  • Engagement Features: Check text styling and interactive elements
  • User Experience: Assess content readability and structure

Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)

  • Engagement Analysis: Track video engagement, interactive elements, and user behavior
  • Content Structure: Optimize headings, FAQs, and table of contents
  • Visual Elements: Analyze images, charts, and interactive components
  • User Experience: Evaluate page layout and content readability

Data Integration & Analysis

  • Google Search Console Integration: Import and analyze search performance data
  • Ahrefs Integration: Access comprehensive backlink and keyword data
  • Custom Reports: Generate detailed SEO and CRO performance reports

💡 Why Choose SEO AI Audit Tool?

  • Save Time: Automated analysis and recommendations
  • Increase Traffic: Target high-potential keywords and optimize content
  • Boost Conversions: Implement proven CRO strategies
  • Stay Competitive: Access the latest SEO and CRO best practices
  • Easy to Use: Intuitive interface with actionable insights

Usage

  1. Running an Audit:

    • Go to SEO AI Audit in your WordPress dashboard.
    • Review the generated report with improvement recommendations.
    • Click on Run Audit to initiate a comprehensive analysis of your website’s SEO elements.
    • Review the generated report highlighting areas of improvement and actionable recommendations.

  2. Importing Data:

    • Navigate to SEO AI Audit > Import GSC & Ahrefs Data.
    • Upload your CSV files from Google Search Console and Ahrefs to enhance the audit accuracy.

  3. Magic Keyword Finder:

    • Access the Magic Keyword Finder from the main menu.
    • Click on Run Magic Keyword Finder to discover optimal keywords tailored to your content strategy.

  4. Managing Focus Pages:

    • Open the Focus Pages modal to select and prioritize the pages you want to optimize.
    • Use the star icons to mark pages as focus pages for targeted SEO efforts.

sections.installation:
1. Download the Plugin:

    • Download the latest version of SEO AI Audit Tool from the WordPress Plugin Repository.

  2. Upload the Plugin:

    • Navigate to your WordPress dashboard.
    • Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
    • Choose the downloaded .zip file and click Install Now.

  3. Activate the Plugin:

    • Once installed, click Activate to enable the SEO AI Audit Tool.

  4. Initial Setup:

    • After activation, navigate to SEO AI Audit in the WordPress admin menu.
    • Follow the on-screen instructions to connect your Google Search Console and Ahrefs accounts.
sections.faq:
How do I connect my Google Search Console and Ahrefs accounts?

After installing the plugin, navigate to SEO AI Audit > Import GSC & Ahrefs Data. Follow the on-screen instructions to securely connect and import data from your Google Search Console and Ahrefs accounts.

Can I customize the audit criteria?

Yes, the plugin follows WordPress codex coding best practices, allowing you to extend and customize the audit criteria as needed. Developers can create new functions with a unique suffix to avoid conflicts.

Is the plugin compatible with Elementor?

Absolutely! SEO AI Audit Tool is fully compatible with Elementor, ensuring seamless integration and enhanced audit capabilities for pages built with Elementor.

How often should I run an SEO audit?

We recommend running an SEO audit at least once a month to stay updated with your website’s performance and implement timely optimizations.

How do I sign up for an OpenAI API key?

To sign up for an OpenAI API key, follow these steps:

  1. Visit OpenAI’s Platform: Go to platform.openai.com and click “Sign Up” in the top right corner.

  2. Create an Account:

    • Enter your email and a password, or use a Google/Microsoft account.
    • Provide your name and verify your phone number with a code sent to you.
    • Check your email for a verification link and click it to activate your account.

  3. Log In:

    • Return to platform.openai.com, click “Log In,” and sign in with your credentials.

  4. Access API Keys:

    • Click your profile icon/name in the dashboard’s top right corner.
    • Select “API Keys” from the menu.

  5. Generate an API Key:

    • Click “Create new secret key” and enter a name (e.g., “Project Key”).
    • Copy the key immediately (it’s shown only once) and store it securely in a password manager.

  6. Set Up Billing:

    • Go to the “Billing” section in your dashboard.
    • Add a valid payment method (credit/debit card). New users get $5 in free credits (expire after three months).
    • API usage requires a payment method after credits are used.

  7. Optional: Manage Usage:

    • In “Usage Limits,” set monthly spending limits to control costs.

Notes:
– Keep your API key private to prevent unauthorized access.
– Revoke compromised keys in the API Keys section and generate new ones.
– Review OpenAI’s pricing for model costs and policies for compliance.

You’re now set to use your API key with OpenAI’s models!
